editorial.body: ① 더불어민주당은 29일 의원총회에서 조작기소 특검법을 10월 1일 본회의에 올리지 않기로 했습니다. ② 민주당은 국정감사 이후를 보겠다며 여지를 남겼지만 법무부 감찰과 법원 판단으로 명분이 약해졌습니다. ③ 대통령이 임명한 특검이 대통령 사건을 수사하는 이해충돌이 크므로 특검법 추진을 접는 게 낫다고 주장했습니다.

법무부 감찰과 법원 판단으로 특검법의 명분이 약해졌다.

editorial.titleTr: Special Prosecutor Law Shelved Over Fabricated Charges Allegation—Right Call, but Scrapping It Entirely Would Be Better
summaryTr: The Democratic Party postponed bringing the special prosecution law for alleged manipulation of indictments to the plenary session on October 1st.
The rationale for the special prosecution law has weakened due to the Justice Ministry's internal investigation and the court's ruling.
There is a major conflict of interest in a special prosecutor appointed by the president investigating cases involving the president.
editorial.bodyTr: The Democratic Party decided at its general assembly on the 29th not to bring the special prosecutor bill to the plenary session on October 1st. The party left room for reconsideration after the state audit, but its justification weakened due to investigations by the Ministry of Justice and court rulings. It argued that it would be better to drop the push for the special prosecutor bill, citing significant conflicts of interest in having a special prosecutor appointed by the president investigate cases involving the president.

editorials.titleTr: Financial Authorities Keep Leverage ETF Data Secret—What Are They Hiding?
summaryTr: Financial authorities are refusing to disclose materials on the introduction of leveraged ETFs.
Individual investors incurred losses of 423.9 billion won over five months following the product's launch.
Allegations have been raised that the Financial Supervisory Service instructed the exclusion of institutional and foreign investor gains and losses from materials submitted to parliament.
editorials.bodyTr: Documents from the process of introducing single-stock leveraged ETFs are not being disclosed due to lack of cooperation from financial authorities. Since the product's launch, increased stock price volatility has concentrated individual investor losses at 423.9 billion won between May 27 and end of July. Suspicions have been raised that the Financial Supervisory Service instructed the removal of institutional and foreign investor gains and losses from materials submitted to the National Assembly.

editorials.titleTr: Agricultural Survey Followed by CPTPP... Government Must First Present Concrete Damage Relief Measures
summaryTr: Farmer groups express concern about 700 billion won in annual losses as government reviews CPTPP membership.
Manufacturing gains expected, but agricultural production decline makes compensation a critical issue.
Trust remains low due to past unfulfilled promises, requiring the government to present concrete implementation plans.
editorials.bodyTr: When the government began reviewing membership in the CPTPP, farm groups opposed the move, citing concerns over annual damages estimated at 700 billion won. According to government analysis, even as manufacturing gains from the agreement, agricultural production would decline due to market opening, making compensation measures a critical task. Past promises to support rural and fishing communities have not been properly kept, eroding trust, so the government must first present concrete implementation plans.

The floor leader's inappropriate actions and political strategy merit sober analysis.

editorial.body: 입력 종합 30면 서부전선 DMZ에서 우리 장병 3명이 다친 지뢰 폭발사건의 실체가 드러나고 있다. 합참은 북한군 매설 지뢰일 가능성이 매우 크다고 밝혔고, 어제 현장 조사에서는 폭발 지점 바로 옆에서 북한군의 수지 반보병 지뢰 1개가 추가로 발견됐다. 강신철 국방장관도 어제 국회 국방위에서 군이 북한 지뢰로 의심한 시점이 사고 다음 날인 22일이었으며, 이번 사안은 명백한 정전협정 위반이라고 규정했다. 강신철 국방부 장관(왼쪽)이 29일 국회 국방위원회 전체회의에서 열린 비무장지대(DMZ) 폭발 사고에 대한 현안 질의에서 의원 질문에 답하고 있다. 임현동 기자/20260929 그런데 사건 발생 8일 만에 나온 이재명 대통령의 첫 메시지는 아쉽다. 신속한 조사를 지시하면서도 북한이나 정전협정 위반은 언급하지 않았다. ‘지뢰 사고’라고 표현하며 “근거 없는 음모론을 부추기면서 국가 안보를 위태롭게 하는 일이 없었으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 근거 없는 주장을 경계하는 건 당연하다. 하지만 군은 이미 사고 다음 날 북한 지뢰 가능성을 의심했다. 국민이 묻는 것은 음모론이 아니라 무엇이 벌어졌고, 왜 막지 못했는지에 대한 사실과 책임이다. 현장 조사가 이미 지체된 상황에서 ‘신속한’ 조사를 지시한 것도 한참 뒤늦은 것이란 지적을 피하기 어렵다. 여권 일각의 인식도 우려스럽다. 진성준 국회 국방위원장은 북한 지뢰가 방어 목적일 가능성을 거론하며 우리 군을 상해할 목적으로 설치했다고 단정하기 어렵다고 했다. 그러나 북한의 MDL 이남 지뢰 매설이 확인된다면 명백한 정전협정 위반이다. 이미 북한군 지뢰가 발견됐고 국방장관도 정전협정 위반으로 규정한 사안을 두고, 북한의 살상 의도를 입증해야 대응할 수 있다는 식의 접근은 경계해야 한다. 엄정한 대응을 촉구해도 모자랄 판에 굳이 북한을 두둔하는 듯한 발언이 국회 국방위원장의 입에서 나왔으니 정부·여당이 이 사건을 원칙대로 처리해 나갈 수 있을지 의문이 앞선다. 반드시 따져야 할 것은 우리 군의 대응이다. 북한은 2024년부터 MDL 일대에서 도로·진지 건설과 지뢰를 매설해 왔다. 왜 우리 군과 안보 당국은 이를 적극적으로 항의하고 저지하지 않았는지, 북한의 최근 군사활동과 지뢰 매설에 대한 대응이 과연 적절했는지 따져봐야 한다. 대응이 미흡했다면 지휘·경계체계의 문제를 밝히고 책임도 물어야 한다. 북한의 지뢰 매설을 저지하지 않고 묵인 내지 소극적으로 대응해 온 결과가 결국 이번 사건으로 이어지는 원인(遠因)이 됐음을 부인하기 어려울 것이다.

editorial.titleTr: [Editorial] North Korea's DMZ Mine Blast Exposes Failure to Prevent Deployment
summaryTr: The DMZ landmine explosion appears to have been definitively planted by North Korean forces, constituting a violation of the armistice agreement.
The president's delayed stance and the ruling party's lukewarm response raise suspicions about principled action.
Our military's failure to prevent North Korean landmine placement is pointed out as the fundamental responsibility.
editorial.bodyTr: The true circumstances of the landmine explosion in the DMZ on the western front that injured three South Korean soldiers are coming to light. The Joint Chiefs of Staff announced that there is a very high possibility the mines were laid by North Korean forces, and in an on-site investigation yesterday, an additional anti-personnel mine was discovered right next to the blast point. Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul stated at the National Assembly's Defense Committee yesterday that the military began suspecting North Korean mines the day after the accident on the 22nd, and characterized this incident as a clear violation of the armistice agreement. However, President Lee Jae-myung's first message, which came eight days after the incident, is disappointing. While instructing a swift investigation, he made no mention of North Korea or armistice violations. He referred to it as a "landmine accident" and said he hoped there would be no "baseless conspiracy theories fueling instability in national security." It is certainly appropriate to be wary of groundless claims. However, the military already suspected North Korean mines the day after the accident. What the public is asking for is not conspiracy theories but facts and accountability regarding what happened and why it could not be prevented. In a situation where the on-site investigation has already been delayed, criticism that instructing a "swift" investigation is far too late is difficult to avoid. The perception within the ruling camp is also concerning. National Assembly Defense Committee Chairman Jin Sung-jun suggested that North Korean mines could have been laid for defensive purposes and said it is difficult to determine they were installed with intent to harm our military. However, if North Korean landmines south of the Military Demarcation Line are confirmed, it is a clear armistice violation. Given that North Korean military mines have already been discovered and the defense minister has characterized this as an armistice violation, we must be cautious about approaches that suggest North Korea's lethal intent must be proven before taking action. It is questionable whether the government and ruling party can handle this incident according to principle when statements that appear to defend North Korea have come from the mouth of the National Assembly's Defense Committee chairman, when stern response is the minimum requirement. What must be thoroughly examined is the military's response. Since 2024, North Korea has been engaged in road and fortification construction and landmine laying around the MDL area. We must ask why our military and security authorities did not actively protest and prevent this, and whether the response to North Korea's recent military activities and landmine laying was appropriate. If the response was insufficient, the shortcomings in command and vigilance systems must be identified and responsibility assigned. It will be difficult to deny that the result of failing to prevent North Korea's landmine laying and responding with acquiescence or inaction has become a root cause leading to this incident.

editorial.title: Fiscal reservoirs
editorial.body: Korea must balance strategic investment with fiscal discipline and debt reduction A tax windfall can be dangerous precisely when it looks permanent. South Korea is enjoying one of those moments. Fueled by a semiconductor upswing and stronger equity markets, national tax revenue this year is expected to exceed the original budget estimate by more than 75 trillion won ($55.3 billion), reaching more than 465 trillion won. That bonanza could swell next year’s Future Response Fund from its planned 162.3 trillion won to more than 200 trillion won. With the national budget set at 820.9 trillion won, the fund could command resources equivalent to more than a quarter of annual government spending. The government calls it a reservoir for strategic investment and fiscal stabilization. At that scale, however, its spending rules matter as much as its purpose. The case for saving part of a cyclical windfall is straightforward. The nation needs sustained investment in artificial intelligence, advanced semiconductors and other technologies whose returns may take years to emerge. A fund can also cushion public finances when tax revenue falls. The problem begins when a growth reserve becomes a convenient place to park ordinary spending. The proposed allocation already blurs that boundary. Of 131 pure spending projects in the initial plan, 125 were retained at their requested levels or increased, while only six were cut. Among them are the 2.93 trillion won basic child allowance, 3.5 trillion won in local growth grants and 1.17 trillion won for rural basic income. These may be legitimate policies, but recurring commitments require recurring revenue. A semiconductor boom will not provide that guarantee. Corporate tax receipts can weaken quickly when chip prices, profits or investment cycles turn. Once a benefit becomes embedded in the budget, however, withdrawing it is far harder. Temporary revenue can create permanent obligations, leaving future taxpayers to fill the gap through higher taxes or additional borrowing. That is particularly costly in a higher-rate world. Korea’s government interest payments have risen from about 17 trillion won in 2020 to roughly 30 trillion won this year. Refinancing debt issued when borrowing costs were unusually low will keep pushing that bill upward. Every won used to retire debt eliminates future interest payments, making debt reduction a certain fiscal return at a time when government borrowing costs are high. The fund’s flexibility also deserves closer scrutiny. Proposed rules would allow major spending items to be adjusted by up to 30 percent without prior parliamentary review. Local subsidy projects could carry funds forward for as long as three years. The entire balance could also be transferred to general accounts when tax revenue falls short. Such provisions may improve administrative agility, but they also make the fund resemble a parallel budget. The National Assembly should review the fund as closely as the regular budget, particularly its project selection, spending changes and transfers to general accounts. Parliamentary scrutiny need not come at the expense of flexibility. Technology investment often requires decisions that cannot wait for a lengthy budget cycle. But flexibility should come with gates. Withdrawals should meet clearly defined statutory conditions, executive reallocation should face a tighter ceiling and spending changes should be disclosed promptly. Projects that fail agreed performance tests should face automatic clawbacks. Most importantly, surplus revenue should have a predetermined claim for debt reduction before money flows into an expansive fund. The fund itself should concentrate on nonrecurring investments with measurable long-term effects, while continuing welfare programs remain in the regular budget and compete openly for scarce resources. The country has been handed an unusual fiscal cushion by an unusually favorable industrial cycle. The sensible response is to preserve its value. summaryTr: 한국이 반도체와 주식시장에서 75조 원대의 세금 횡재를 얻게 되면서 전략적 투자를 촉진할 수 있는 기회를 맞고 있다.
정부는 일시적 수입을 미래 예산이 감당할 수 없는 항구적 지출 프로그램에 반영하려는 유혹을 피해야 한다.
기술 투자는 엄격한 국회 감시를 받아야 하는 가운데 재정 건전성을 위해 부채 감축이 재량적 지출보다 우선시돼야 한다.
editorial.bodyTr:
한국은 전략적 투자와 재정규율, 그리고 부채 감축 사이의 균형을 맞춰야 한다

조세 수입의 급증은 영구적으로 보일 때 특히 위험할 수 있다. 한국은 현재 그러한 시점을 맞이하고 있다. 반도체 경기 회복과 주식시장 강세에 힘입어 올해 국세 수입이 원래 예산 추정치보다 75조 원 이상(553억 달러) 초과하여 465조 원 이상에 달할 것으로 예상되고 있다. 이러한 호황으로 내년 미래대응기금의 규모가 계획된 162조 3천억 원에서 200조 원 이상으로 늘어날 수 있다. 정부 예산이 820조 9천억 원으로 책정된 가운데 이 기금은 연간 정부 지출의 4분의 1 이상에 해당하는 규모를 자랑하게 될 것이다. 정부는 이를 전략적 투자와 재정 안정화를 위한 저수지라고 부른다. 하지만 이 정도 규모에서는 기금의 목적만큼 지출 규칙이 중요하다.

경기 변동 성 수입의 일부를 저축해야 한다는 논리는 간단하다. 한국은 인공지능, 첨단 반도체 및 수익이 나타나는 데 수년이 걸릴 수 있는 기타 기술에 대한 지속적인 투자가 필요하다. 기금은 또한 세수가 감소할 때 공공 재정에 충격을 완화할 수 있다. 문제는 성장 적립금이 일상적 지출을 주차하기 편한 장소가 될 때 시작된다. 초기 계획의 131개 순수 지출 사업 중 125개가 요청 수준으로 유지되거나 증가했으며 단 6개만 삭감되었다. 이들 중에는 293조 원 규모의 기본 아동수당, 350조 원의 지역성장기금, 117조 원의 농어민기본소득이 포함되어 있다. 이러한 정책들이 정당할 수도 있지만 반복되는 약속은 반복되는 수입을 필요로 한다. 반도체 호황이 그러한 보장을 제공하지 못할 것이다. 기업 세수는 칩 가격, 이익 또는 투자 사이클이 변할 때 빠르게 악화될 수 있다. 그러나 일단 혜택이 예산에 내재되면 이를 철회하기는 훨씬 더 어렵다. 임시 수입이 영구적 의무를 만들 수 있으며, 이는 미래 납세자들이 더 높은 세금이나 추가 차입을 통해 공백을 메우도록 남길 수 있다. 이는 더 높은 금리 환경에서 특히 비용이 많이 든다. 한국 정부의 이자 지급액은 2020년 약 17조 원에서 올해 약 30조 원으로 증가했다. 차입 비용이 비정상적으로 낮았을 때 발행된 채무를 재융자하는 것은 그 청구액을 계속 상향시킬 것이다. 채무 상환에 사용된 모든 원화는 미래의 이자 지급을 제거하므로 정부 차입 비용이 높은 시점에서 채무 감축은 확실한 재정 수익이다.

기금의 유연성도 더 면밀한 검토를 받아야 한다. 제안된 규칙에 따르면 주요 지출 항목은 사전 국회 검토 없이 최대 30%까지 조정될 수 있다. 지역 보조금 사업은 최대 3년까지 자금을 이월할 수 있다. 전체 잔액은 세수가 부족할 때 일반회계로 이전될 수도 있다. 이러한 조항들은 행정의 민첩성을 개선할 수 있지만 기금이 또 다른 예산처럼 보이도록 만든다. 국회는 기금을 정규 예산만큼 면밀히 검토해야 하며, 특히 사업 선정, 지출 변화 및 일반회계로의 이전을 검토해야 한다. 국회의 감시가 유연성을 해칠 필요는 없다. 기술 투자는 종종 긴 예산 사이클을 기다릴 수 없는 결정을 필요로 한다. 하지만 유연성은 제약 조건과 함께 와야 한다. 인출은 명확히 정의된 법정 조건을 충족해야 하고, 행정부의 재배치는 더 낮은 한도에 직면해야 하며, 지출 변화는 신속히 공개되어야 한다. 합의된 성과 테스트에 실패한 사업은 자동 환수에 직면해야 한다. 가장 중요하게는 잉여 수입이 확장적 기금으로 돈이 흐르기 전에 채무 감축을 위한 미리 정해진 청구권을 가져야 한다. 기금 자체는 측정 가능한 장기 효과를 가진 비반복 투자에 집중해야 하며, 지속적인 복지 프로그램은 정규 예산에 남아 부족한 자원을 위해 공개적으로 경쟁해야 한다. 한국은 비정상적으로 유리한 산업 사이클에 의해 비정상적인 재정 완충제를 받았다. 현명한 대응은 그 가치를 보존하는 것이다. 저수지는 날씨가 바뀔 때를 위해 물을 보관하기 때문에 유용하다. 그 규모가 모두가 그것에서 인출하기 시작하도록 장려할 때 덜 유용해진다.

editorials.title: Fiscal reservoirs
editorials.body: Korea must balance strategic investment with fiscal discipline and debt reduction A tax windfall can be dangerous precisely when it looks permanent. South Korea is enjoying one of those moments. Fueled by a semiconductor upswing and stronger equity markets, national tax revenue this year is expected to exceed the original budget estimate by more than 75 trillion won ($55.3 billion), reaching more than 465 trillion won. That bonanza could swell next year’s Future Response Fund from its planned 162.3 trillion won to more than 200 trillion won. With the national budget set at 820.9 trillion won, the fund could command resources equivalent to more than a quarter of annual government spending. The government calls it a reservoir for strategic investment and fiscal stabilization. At that scale, however, its spending rules matter as much as its purpose. The case for saving part of a cyclical windfall is straightforward. The nation needs sustained investment in artificial intelligence, advanced semiconductors and other technologies whose returns may take years to emerge. A fund can also cushion public finances when tax revenue falls. The problem begins when a growth reserve becomes a convenient place to park ordinary spending. The proposed allocation already blurs that boundary. Of 131 pure spending projects in the initial plan, 125 were retained at their requested levels or increased, while only six were cut. Among them are the 2.93 trillion won basic child allowance, 3.5 trillion won in local growth grants and 1.17 trillion won for rural basic income. These may be legitimate policies, but recurring commitments require recurring revenue. A semiconductor boom will not provide that guarantee. Corporate tax receipts can weaken quickly when chip prices, profits or investment cycles turn. Once a benefit becomes embedded in the budget, however, withdrawing it is far harder. Temporary revenue can create permanent obligations, leaving future taxpayers to fill the gap through higher taxes or additional borrowing. That is particularly costly in a higher-rate world. Korea’s government interest payments have risen from about 17 trillion won in 2020 to roughly 30 trillion won this year. Refinancing debt issued when borrowing costs were unusually low will keep pushing that bill upward. Every won used to retire debt eliminates future interest payments, making debt reduction a certain fiscal return at a time when government borrowing costs are high. The fund’s flexibility also deserves closer scrutiny. Proposed rules would allow major spending items to be adjusted by up to 30 percent without prior parliamentary review. Local subsidy projects could carry funds forward for as long as three years. The entire balance could also be transferred to general accounts when tax revenue falls short. Such provisions may improve administrative agility, but they also make the fund resemble a parallel budget. The National Assembly should review the fund as closely as the regular budget, particularly its project selection, spending changes and transfers to general accounts. Parliamentary scrutiny need not come at the expense of flexibility. Technology investment often requires decisions that cannot wait for a lengthy budget cycle. But flexibility should come with gates. Withdrawals should meet clearly defined statutory conditions, executive reallocation should face a tighter ceiling and spending changes should be disclosed promptly. Projects that fail agreed performance tests should face automatic clawbacks. Most importantly, surplus revenue should have a predetermined claim for debt reduction before money flows into an expansive fund. The fund itself should concentrate on nonrecurring investments with measurable long-term effects, while continuing welfare programs remain in the regular budget and compete openly for scarce resources. The country has been handed an unusual fiscal cushion by an unusually favorable industrial cycle. The sensible response is to preserve its value. A reservoir is useful because it holds water for when the weather changes. It becomes less useful when its size encourages everyone to start drawing from it. 기금의 유연성도 더 면밀한 검토를 받아야 한다. 제안된 규칙에 따르면 주요 지출 항목은 사전 국회 검토 없이 최대 30%까지 조정될 수 있다. 지역 보조금 사업은 최대 3년까지 자금을 이월할 수 있다. 전체 잔액은 세수가 부족할 때 일반회계로 이전될 수도 있다. 이러한 조항들은 행정의 민첩성을 개선할 수 있지만 기금이 또 다른 예산처럼 보이도록 만든다. 국회는 기금을 정규 예산만큼 면밀히 검토해야 하며, 특히 사업 선정, 지출 변화 및 일반회계로의 이전을 검토해야 한다. 국회의 감시가 유연성을 해칠 필요는 없다. 기술 투자는 종종 긴 예산 사이클을 기다릴 수 없는 결정을 필요로 한다. 하지만 유연성은 제약 조건과 함께 와야 한다. 인출은 명확히 정의된 법정 조건을 충족해야 하고, 행정부의 재배치는 더 낮은 한도에 직면해야 하며, 지출 변화는 신속히 공개되어야 한다. 합의된 성과 테스트에 실패한 사업은 자동 환수에 직면해야 한다. 가장 중요하게는 잉여 수입이 확장적 기금으로 돈이 흐르기 전에 채무 감축을 위한 미리 정해진 청구권을 가져야 한다. 기금 자체는 측정 가능한 장기 효과를 가진 비반복 투자에 집중해야 하며, 지속적인 복지 프로그램은 정규 예산에 남아 부족한 자원을 위해 공개적으로 경쟁해야 한다. 한국은 비정상적으로 유리한 산업 사이클에 의해 비정상적인 재정 완충제를 받았다. 현명한 대응은 그 가치를 보존하는 것이다. 저수지는 날씨가 바뀔 때를 위해 물을 보관하기 때문에 유용하다. 그 규모가 모두가 그것에서 인출하기 시작하도록 장려할 때 덜 유용해진다.

editorial.titleTr: [Editorial] North Korea Must Cooperate in Clarifying DMZ Mine Incident
summaryTr: Joint Chiefs of Staff announce high likelihood that DMZ explosion mine is of North Korean origin
Three soldiers seriously wounded, need emerges to clarify cause of incident
Crucial to confirm final details on whether North Korea's provocation was intentional
editorial.bodyTr:
The Joint Chiefs of Staff released intermediate investigation results on the 28th indicating that the anti-personnel mine that seriously wounded three South Korean soldiers has "a very high possibility of being North Korean," heightening the need to precisely determine the cause of this incident. If a final conclusion is reached that this constitutes a deliberate provocation by the North, our military will have to take a corresponding response, and the security situation on the Korean Peninsula could deteriorate rapidly.

The mine explosion that occurred in the demilitarized zone on the 24th is an extremely serious incident that cannot be overlooked. Two soldiers were injured in the blast, and one soldier lost both legs in the subsequent search and rescue operations. This is a clear violation of the Korean Armistice Agreement, which requires both North and South Korea to refrain from hostile acts in the DMZ.

North Korea has been consistently denying responsibility, claiming it has no knowledge of the incident. However, the investigation results pointing to North Korean mines are based on scientific analysis of the explosive materials and components found at the scene. If the North continues to deny responsibility despite such evidence, it would only expose its dishonesty to the international community.

What is most concerning is that this incident could be a harbinger of further provocations. The security situation on the peninsula remains fragile, and any escalation could have serious consequences. Our military must strengthen vigilance and prepare for all possible scenarios while pursuing diplomatic channels to prevent further incidents.

The government should exhaust all diplomatic efforts to prevent the situation from escalating while firmly responding to any further provocations. At the same time, it must ensure that the truth about this incident is clearly established and communicated to both the domestic public and the international community.

Labor union pragmatism includes early Friday closings.
editorials.bodyTr: The financial sector's labor and management have reached a tentative agreement to delay bank branch opening times from 9 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. starting next April.
